chapter: Europe and the Black and Blue years
title: Swedish concerts, TV show and working with local musicians
summary: She did a TV show and two club concerts, closing the show as the only American star. She brings no band or scores, only lead sheets, and the European musicians are excellent.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: How many concerts did you do?
I did a TV show. And then I just did that one night at the club. But I did two --- one in the evening and one at night, (concerts).

Oh.
But there was other people on it.
Oh, was it a club or like an auditorium?
It was like a big club.
Oh.
And then at the TV station, it was a big television place.
Was it the same band that accompanied you both times?
No. A big band at the studio. But I just had a small group at the....
How did you manage the language with the big band? Do the people talk in English?
Yeah, because I didn't talk nothing but English. I don't have trouble getting people to understand me. I don't know nothing about that language.
Well, of course they know. They are familiar with the music. Did you, when you go like that you don't bring music, you don't bring a score for the band, do you?
I just bring my little piano and bass and drum.
Oh, you do. Did you have your own

Yeah, they have beautiful musicians.
Do they?
Oh yes indeed.
Well, when you say there were some other people at the club. Were they other Americans?
